full_judgment: 2. The municipal holding bearing No. 22, Rajani Chowdhury Road under P.S. Sutrapur, Dacca originally belonged to Sk. Abdul Aziz and his wife Moriam of village Kamarkhola under P. S. Nawabganj, District Dacca. They had owned and possessed the same physically up to 12-2-74, when they executed a General Power of Attorney in favour of one Sk. Md. Abdul Mannan, son of late Abdul Hatnid of Village Churian under P S Nawabganj, Dacca authorizing the said Sk. Abdul Mannan to do all acts, deeds or things for on their behalf including disposal of the holding by the sale. Sk. Md. Abdul Mannan on the strength of the Power of Attorney executed a sale deed in favour of the petitioner and four other sale deeds in favour of his four brothers on 17.1.75 and gave delivery of possession of the holding to the petitioner. Since then the petitioner and his brothers have been living in the holding. The petitioner has s also got his name and the names of his brothers mutated in the Municipality, Dacca Electricity and WASA, and paid rent, taxes and other charges. He has also his name and the names of his brothers recorded in the record of rights and paid rent. While the petitioner and his four brothers have thus been possessing the holding, the respondent No. 2, a Section Officer of respondent No. 1, on a wrong information star-ted a proceeding under President's Order No. 16 of 1972 in November, 1976 with a view to treat the property as an abandoned property. The petitioner gave a representation on 25.11.76 praying not to treat the property as an abandoned property and also not to disturb the possession of the petitioner and his brothers. But the said representation has been rejected by the impugned order dated 18.4.77 (Annexure-D). The petitioner having no other remedy had then moved this court and obtained the rule.
